name: dsfd_vm_fcn_m5-p4-COMMIT
purpose: el1013-s81-vmfe/B6 dsfd_vm_fe_h leaf dsfd_vm_fcn at M5 (central: command decode, counter K, done mux, ports 2 / 5 .. 9 order registers, reset root; dv / dt on a stream pin register); contract dsfd_vm_fe_h_if.svh after S2 (slice words carry only non-constant bits) / S3 (clt RT 1) / S5 (flag relay, one relay tile a lane); outline 239.76 x 51.84; pin faces by data flow, bit-ordered ranges. structural_change: B8, coordinator decision 10-13 (a): engine adapter XRT 1 = one reset synchroniser a clock domain on the pin-level AND rst & rss, then a registered reset tree (3 kept copies a domain); its two ot_async_fifo build no conditioner (EXT_RST), so no flop of one domain reaches a reset pin of the other (gate 172927: recovery -334.3 ps on u_er.reset_pipe -> wr_reset_conditioner); KD 3 pre-stages for the own ports / ARM ops; p4: recipe2 pin flops and hold stages at pins, 30ps hold margin, face-pin access keepout.

reroute_reason.why_route: Prior p2 FLD route failed child_lint pin access; B9 FCN CTS found boundary dv reg-to-output -244 ps. Recipe2 places pin flops and hold stages at the actual pins, and clears above face pins.
